summary: Send private money as a link to anyone without requiring prior registration.
description_long: The project implements a STRK20 anonymizer contract that allows users to shield tokens, seal them in an envelope, and send a link to the recipient. description_long: This project allows users to send encrypted messages on Starknet without revealing sender or recipient identities. summary: Provide infrastructure for autonomous AI agent negotiations and settlements.
